boundary_decisions.title: 外接AI
boundary_decisions.decision: Chat/Inline Chat/Copilot/Agents/AI completions/AI search/MCP代理等按依赖逐项排除；普通编辑共享组件保留

boundary_decisions.title: Canvas与Agent专用界面
boundary_decisions.decision: 当前Canvas菜单受ChatContextKeys.enabled控制；不当作普通非AI画布；将来若独立默认能力需重审

boundary_decisions.title: Python/C++/Rust等完整业务provider
boundary_decisions.decision: 默认语法/snippets纳入LNG；需用户安装的LSP/调试/测试能力不归入默认复刻，现有RA另记附加能力

boundary_decisions.title: Jupyter执行与kernel
boundary_decisions.decision: 保留NBK宿主/ipynb/renderer；额外Jupyter/Python provider的执行/变量浏览不冒称默认可用

boundary_decisions.title: 测试框架provider
boundary_decisions.decision: pytest/JUnit/Jest等需要用户扩展；保留Testing UI与协议空态，测试fixture仅用于验证宿主

boundary_decisions.title: Remote SSH/WSL/Containers/Codespaces业务扩展
boundary_decisions.decision: 默认未随附的连接provider排除；内置远程指示/Ports/Tunnel实际能力仍在NET

boundary_decisions.title: GitHub PR-Issues与Remote Repositories业务
boundary_decisions.decision: GitHub基础认证/clone/publish纳入；用户扩展PR/Issues/remotehub能力不自动纳入

boundary_decisions.title: 任意第三方vscode API兼容
boundary_decisions.decision: 通用扩展运行时不是本次产品目标；扩展管理自身功能纳入NET，受支持状态必须诚实

boundary_decisions.title: 额外主题语法语言包
boundary_decisions.decision: 默认包全部纳入；用户导入数据格式兼容按THM/LNG测试，不要求所有外部包业务可用

boundary_decisions.title: 源码测试与构建辅助
boundary_decisions.decision: vscode-api-tests/colorize-tests/test-resolver/types等不是默认用户功能；可复用测试数据不算产品需求

boundary_decisions.title: 实验和默认关闭功能
boundary_decisions.decision: 先登记flag/平台/可达性，不直接删除；范围内有设置入口的非AI能力仍需条件case

boundary_decisions.title: 官方服务和预置包不可用
boundary_decisions.decision: 不属于排除：保持NET/P00阻塞项，替代实现与官方互通分别签收

boundary_decisions.title: 系统依赖缺失
boundary_decisions.decision: 不属于排除：Git/运行时/shell缺失要有相同前提检测，具备条件时验收真实能力

boundary_decisions.title: 品牌名称和标识
boundary_decisions.decision: Alula自有名称与图标单列可见差异；不据此削减功能/布局/交互验收
